posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a May photo dump featuring a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan and celebrated Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday with an intimate family gathering.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit announced a historic Wembley Stadium show on September 12, becoming the first South Asian artist to headline the venue. His new film Main Vaapas Aunga with Imtiaz Ali is also generating buzz.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's spy thriller Alpha with Sharvari has been preponed to a July 3 release. She continues filming Love & War alongside Ranbir Kapoor and Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka shared heartwarming 'Random March' family moments with Nick Jonas and daughter Malti, and made a quick trip to Mumbai that had fans buzzing.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is wrapping his action thriller King for a Christmas 2026 release. Lalit Modi revealed SRK's early KKR investment story, and he's reportedly considering a romantic drama next.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped shooting for Daayra directed by Meghna Gulzar. Her safari vacation photos with Taimur and Jeh are trending across social media.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha suffered a fracture during the shoot of Eetha. She's also rumored for a Kalpana Chawla biopic and continues to be spotted with partner Rahul Mody.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy while filming Raka with Allu Arjun and Atlee. A body double is handling her action sequences as she continues work on King with SRK.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: The FWICE non-cooperation directive against Ranveer over his Don 3 exit was lifted on June 3 after he sent a legal notice. His Dhurandhar franchise continues its massive box office run.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya and daughter Aaradhya turned heads with their twinning airport looks. She made a stunning appearance at Cannes 2025 that kept the internet talking.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 trailer with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon launched ahead of its June 19 release. Wedding rumors with Vijay Deverakonda continue to swirl.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha married Raj Nidimoru in a dreamy ceremony. She dropped the teaser for Maa Inti Bangaaram and was announced as a Good Game global ambassador.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is deep into filming Raka with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone, with a body double arrangement for Deepika's action scenes generating industry chatter.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi with Janhvi Kapoor and AR Rahman's music releases June 4. Advance bookings have already crossed $870K in North America alone.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with director Prashanth Neel is generating massive buzz. The director praised NTR's creative input over five years of development, and Shahid Kapoor is in talks for the antagonist role.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in Peddi releasing June 4 with massive advance bookings. She recently opened up about her hesitation towards Malayalam cinema.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya is filming Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya and has Call Me Bae Season 2 coming up, riding on the success of Kesari: Chapter 2.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed their first baby girl. She spoke candidly about dealing with post-pregnancy body shaming on social media.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik announced his directorial debut with a social thriller, entering production soon. He celebrated son Hrehaan's 20th birthday after War 2's massive box office run.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun is busy promoting Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai and signed a deal as Lux Cozi brand ambassador through 2030. Border 2 updates are also keeping fans excited.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released the devotional single Siddha Bhajo and purchased a Rs 29.7 crore home in Mumbai's Worli. She also dropped a live album from her All Hearts Tour.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Ram Charan's Peddi releasing June 4. He turned 59 and is co-producing the film Masoom amid clarifications over recent communal bias comments.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's TVK party won 108 seats in the Tamil Nadu elections, making him Chief Minister. His final film Jana Nayagan is set for release after censor delays and a leak controversy.
